result.explanation: The payment for order ord_0904 was confirmed (payments:pay_0904) and the order marked paid (orders:ord_0904), triggering a grant of 10 credits (grants:g_ord_0904). However, the subsequent email send failed because the mail provider reported a missing API key (server_logs:2026-10-18T18:00:09Z@/api/mail/send), so the customer received the credits but no notification.
result.customer_reply: Your payment of 9900 KRW was successful and 10 credits were added to your account. The confirmation email was not sent due to a technical issue with our mail service. We will request approval to resend that notification so you receive it.
result.fix_action: Resend the credit mail (requires approval). Code fix: alert on mail/send errors and retry with backoff.
